cases.name: Elizabeth Elena Laguna-Salgado
cases.dateDetail: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; LAST KNOWN ALIVE / SEEN
cases.about: She was a native of Mexico and a convert to The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints and had moved to Provo to study English just three weeks before she went missing. She was a waitress and was active in her church.
cases.narrative: On 5/28/2018, her skeletal remains were found by a man driving through the area, who seeking privacy, had walked from the roadway to an off-trail area. That’s when he saw a human skull, with bones and some fabric nearby.
